CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization/access present.

COD.rationale: Each p0/current/n# item includes explicit content coordinates (red/blue) and separate origin/presentation metadata, meeting C, O and D for each referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to the content's organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Report lists explicit content identifiers (color-labeled items) with coordinate attributes.

D.rationale: Origin/presentation metadata are provided separately from content coordinates, distinguishing content identity from presentation status.

O.rationale: Report specifies how items are presented (origin metadata, shown_at) and the grid layout rule.
